entry.subject: roof_framing_method
entry.content: Scope language is 'truss or rafter TBD in design phase' — this is explicit design ambiguity, which per CLAUDE.md addition rules means the default is stick-frame. The footprint at 789 sqft is just under the 800 sqft truss threshold, so no procurement.trusses task should be emitted unless PM confirms trusses.
entry.falsification_test: PM Interview confirming trusses, or a revised scope explicitly specifying trusses, would require adding procurement.trusses.

entry.subject: water_heater_scope_classification
entry.content: The scope describes extending the existing gas water heater vent only — no new tank or tankless unit is being installed in the base scope. The breakdown section title 'Incl. Tankless WH Option' suggests the tankless WH may be an optional add; this distinction matters for the plumbing task graph (no tank_set task required unless option is exercised).
entry.falsification_test: A confirmed change order or PM interview confirming the tankless WH is in-scope would falsify this.

entry.subject: hall_bath_retrofit_classification
entry.content: The 'Existing Hall Bath Mod, Bedroom Remodel & Closeout' section fires all three retrofit signals (Signal A: hall bath is not in the addition objective; Signal B: 'existing'; the negative section total suggests credit/scope reduction). This must be modeled as a separate retrofit component, not commingled with new-construction work.
entry.falsification_test: A revised scope placing hall bath work inside the addition footprint would change this classification.
